value.body: A two-year master's in sociology covering social theory, research methods, and fields such as caste, gender, family, urban and rural society, and development. Most programmes include a dissertation or fieldwork component.

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A bachelor's degree — many universities accept any discipline, some prefer sociology at UG. Admission is through CUET-PG for central and many other universities, university entrance tests, or merit.

value.title: At a glance
items: UGC-NET qualification is needed for assistant professor posts; JRF adds a research fellowship for a PhD.
Research methods and fieldwork skills carry over to development-sector, survey and policy-research roles.
Sociology is a popular UPSC Civil Services optional subject.
Pay in NGOs and research projects is often modest and contract-based early on.
